source_target: Figure 6 geometry estimated from one million fresh default-initialized D=256 iDDPM U-Nets under the default zero-input and uniformly sampled timestep probe.

shard_contract.aggregation: streaming arithmetic mean of score outer products

aggregate_contract: Two prespecified disjoint 500000-network seed shards are averaged with equal weight. Only that aggregate may be described as the paper-scale one-million-network geometry.
direction_gate: Before an interior SAD enters generation experiments, its individual-vector overlap and its local 9-vector band overlap must be audited across independent half-million shards. Near-degenerate unstable vectors cannot be treated as identifiable.
integrity_failure: The verifier exits nonzero on wrong counts, insufficient CPU affinity, PSD/eigen residual failure, payload hash or independent eigensolver disagreement, GPU use, or a negative control that is not rejected.
claim_verdict: This shard alone cannot verify or falsify either claim.
